title.narrative: Provision of lifesaving integrated nutrition and health services to the vulnerable communities affected by the drought in Lasqorey District (LAAS RESPONSE)

description.narrative: ltpgtCARE International will implement an integrated emergency health and nutrition response targeting vulnerable women and children affected by the ongoing drought in Lasqorey District, Sanaag Region. In collaboration with the Ministry of Health (MoH) of Puntland, the project will focus on 10 fixed health centers and 10 drought-affected villages, aiming to reach 30,000 individuals, including 8,700 women, 400 men, 10,200 girls, and 10,700 boys. CARE will provide outpatient consultations for common illnesses such as diarrhea, acute respiratory infections, influenza, malaria, measles, and pneumonia through both static and mobile health services. Nurse clinicians will follow Somalia’s national treatment protocols and Integrated Management of Childhood Illness (IMCI) guidelines, translated into Somali for accessibility.ltbrgtSexual and reproductive health services will includeantenatal and postnatal care,basic emergency Obstetric and Newborn Care (BEmONC),Referral services for Comprehensive Emergency Obstetric and Newborn Care (CEmONC), including cesarean sections and blood transfusions, to Badhan and Dhahar Hospitals or Garowe depending on availability of services needed. ltbrgtCommunity engagement will be central to the intervention. Community Health Workers (CHWs) will lead community level treatment, awareness sessions to promote health-seeking behaviors and address harmful practices. Survivors of Sexual and Gender-Based Violence (SGBV) will receive confidential Clinical Management of Rape (CMR) services in accordance with WHO and MoH guidelines and further to referral to KAALO organizations for other non-clinical survivor centered services.ltbrgtCARE will procure and distribute essential medicines and medical equipment to ensure availability of essential medical supplies and equipment that are aligned with Somalia’s Essential Medicines List and compliance with UN OCHA and CARE procurement standards.ltbrgtTo strengthen local capacity, CARE will:Train health workers on IMCI, BEmONC, clinical management of rape, disease surveillance, and health information management. CARE will also provide technical support and capacity building to MoH staff to ensure sustainability beyond the project period.ltbrgtThe intervention will also provide management of facility-based and community-based management of acute malnutrition (CMAM). Routine screening and identification of children with acute malnutrition through a facility- and community-based approach. Severely malnourished cases without medical complications will be enrolled into the OTP program for treatment as well as Moderately malnourished children and PLWs. Children with SAM and medical complications will be referred to Badhan and Dhahar stabilization Centers (SCs) or nearby referral hospitals for inpatient care. CARE will adopt a comprehensive IYCF in Emergencies (IYCF-E) strategy, engaging not only mothers but also fathers, grandparents, community leaders, religious figures, and teachers to foster a supportive environment for improved child nutrition and care practices. Mother support groups will be established and supported to promote IYCF sessions in the IDP camps. ltbrgtCARE will coordinate with partners- TASS and KALO who will be implementing Food security, WASH, MHPSS and protection services in the same locality to ensure harmonized delivery of health, nutrition, WASH, Food security, Mental health and protection services. ltbrgtCARE leads in some of key coordination platforms in Puntland and will continue to collaborate with other humanitarian actors and share project updates to ensure transparency and avoid duplication as well as develop long term strategies to address sustainability and local actors' capacity building.ltbrgtHealth Fcailities targetted under thsi intervention are Carmale HC, Hadaftimo HC, Mindigale HC,Habar-shiro HC,Balibusle HC,Baraagahaqol HC,Buraan HC,Xingalool HC,Cawsane HC,Ceelaayo HC,Kaladhacda HC,Kulmiye HC,Sibaayo PHU,Rad PHU,Laako PHU ,Durduri PHU ,Ulxeed PHUltbrgtlt/pgt
